touches.text: Transient: things held for seconds to days (mail, logs, test runs, trouble tickets, inference tickets). The logging tree.

VERBS: status queries only (show, get), and crossing, the notice a ticket sends as it moves, which keeps the register. It answers no gate and moves no ticket. A ticket that would cross a gate asks that gate itself for an inspection, and either receives a pass or sends itself back to design (3.3.4). WHY: Akien, 2026-11-10: "why would the harbor master's bus face answer anything other than a status query. if anything (ticket) is going to try and cross a gate it's the ticket that asks that gate for an inspection. and the ticket either recieves a pass or it sends itself back to design." Measured the same day: the bus face also answers `clear` (fires clearance.py and moves a boat) and `watch` (sends a ticket to FIXME), and both leave. COMMANDS: cairn codemother harbor_master -> "652 boats (570 open, 82 in port)".
Runs a proof as its own process and writes a validation record (claim, caller, date, method, verdict, evidence, falsifier, horizon).
Hollow runs: proves a proof goes red when the build is removed.
Seals: one current validation per proof, beside the proof. A seal holds while the code it measured is unchanged.
TOOLS: base, validation_store, proof_coverage, scratch, question, proof_discovery, chain, bus_client, artifact, system_word; machine build_inspector; db client.
VERBS: run, notices, CodeMother's verbs reached over the bus (RULE 1). COMMANDS: cairn codemother test (--hollow, --seal, --exec, ...), shortcut cairn test; proofgate (the hook: proofs run by hand).

Skills (skills/: cairnhelp, challenge, chart, commit, intent, sorted, ...) are Claude Code's. The deterministic parts move out of markdown into CC device verbs: a skill's OS-side work runs as a script, and CC's shim processes the result and injects it into the session. WHY: every habit captured that way is one CC no longer spends inference on, so CC gets faster; a first charting pass done in deterministic Python with no LLM until after saved about 90% of tokens, measured in real use.

PURPOSE: The engine of a learning block: input -> candidates -> evaluate -> decide or escalate. In the walk's terms (4.3.1.9): decide is a walk that landed, and the deposit reinforces its path; escalate is a miss, first to the LLM (4.3.1.9.5), and when the LLM returns nothing usable, a question to the operator (17.19).

WHY: Many devices learn in the same shape; one engine, held by each, holding its trees by the librarian's delegation (4.3.1.4). "a learning block is a composite thing with many parts, it's a machine."
scratch: a proof's throwaway temp dirs and worktrees, cleaned up by the door. WHY: a run must leave nothing behind (4.3.1.7). USERS: the tester.
